description: The zero-friction entry point for KAZM personalization. Pass whatever you know — listener_id, email, or just a name — and this tool either returns the existing profile or silently creates one in a single call. No separate registration step needed. Call this at the start of every listener session.

email.description: Listener's email address — used to find or link their profile

genres.description: Favorite music genres — set on creation or update

language.description: Preferred language — set on creation, or updates existing profile

listener_id.description: The listener's unique KAZM ID if already known (from custom instructions or previous session)

location.description: City and country — set on creation or update

name.description: Listener's name — used when creating a new profile

name: get_or_create_listener
title: Get or Create Listener
